decisions.reason: As the flagship platform closely aligned with the firm's strategic direction and built on established capabilities, it is unlikely to fall below aspirations, so management keeps it to support future growth.
Because mobile field data capture fits the firm's established geospatial offer and likely meets performance aspirations, the firm has no immediate problemistic search pressure to drop it.

The search extension is close to established web map products and, despite limited standalone web presence, likely contributes to integrated solutions and can be carried with organizational slack while its future role is evaluated.
